climb: After restitution, this dock is 0 (Stranger) unless Beautiful Ones graft cap holds. Jobs board mining, trade, hunt, passenger, explore, spy, and war add +2 to this dock's flag.
That is how standing climbs from 0. Five such jobs reach Known 10. Patrol adds +5 Freehold Compact only.
